relations.text: ADSが10-Kで、売上の13.1%を占める最大顧客と記載
relations.text_en: ADS says Ferguson accounted for 13.1% of its net sales

source.label: Advanced Drainage Systems 10-K(2026年3月期)
source.quote: Ferguson Enterprises ("Ferguson") accounted for 13.1% and Core & Main, Inc. ("Core & Main") accounted for 12.8% of fiscal 2026 net sales.

relations.text: Mascoが10-Kで、Fergusonへの販売を失うリスクを記載
relations.text_en: Masco flags the risk of losing its sales to Ferguson

source.label: Masco 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we might not be able to quickly replace, or replace at all, the loss of a substantial portion of our sales to The Home Depot or the loss of all of our sales to either Ferguson or Lowe's.

relations.text: FGIが10-Kで、最大級の顧客の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: FGI names Ferguson among its largest customers

source.label: FGI Industries 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Some of our largest customers include The Home Depot, Menards, Ferguson and Lowe's.

source.quote: W. W. Grainger, Inc. (including Zoro and other divisions), MSC Industrial Direct Co., Inc., Amazon Supply, Office Depot, Staples, Northern Tool & Equipment Company, Inc., Uline, Inc., Fastenal Co., HD Supply, Supply Basket, LLC (a/k/a SupplyBasket.com), Ferguson Enterprises, Inc., McMaster-Carr Supply Company

relations.text: MRC Globalが契約で、競合事業としてFergusonの産業部門を挙げる
relations.text_en: MRC Global names Ferguson's industrial business as a competing business in an agreement

source.quote: businesses that compete with the Company's business include (without limitation) the distribution business to the energy industry of NOW Inc., RK Supply, Elite Supply, Jet Specialty, Charbonneau Industries, the Sunbelt business of Floworks, Russell Metals, Score Group, the industrial business of Ferguson/Wolseley
